main.billing_credit_note: Refunds or credits issued against an invoice, with the reason; answers how much money was given back to customers and why.
main.billing_invoice: Invoices issued to customers for orders, with due dates, totals and payment status; answers what customers owe and which invoices are unpaid or overdue.
main.billing_invoice_line: Individual priced items on each invoice with quantity, tax and line totals; answers what exactly was billed on an invoice.
main.billing_payment: Payments received against invoices, with date, method and reference; answers who has paid, when and how.
main.billing_tax_rate: Sales tax percentages by country and effective date; answers what tax rate applies when billing a customer in a given country.
main.cat_category: Hierarchical product categories with parent links; answers how products are grouped and how deep the category tree is.
main.cat_price_list: Named price lists with currency and validity dates; answers which pricing schedules exist and when each applies.
main.cat_price_list_item: The selling price of each product on each price list, with minimum quantity; answers what we charge for an item.
main.cat_product: The product catalogue with SKU, list price, unit of measure and status; answers what products we sell.
main.cat_product_attribute: Key/value attributes attached to products such as colour or size; answers the descriptive properties of a product.
main.core_address: Postal addresses with city, postcode and country, tagged by use; answers where a party, warehouse or delivery is located.
main.core_country: Reference list of countries with ISO code and region; answers which country or region a record belongs to.
main.core_party: Every organisation or person the business deals with, shared by customers, suppliers and employees; answers who a party is and their primary address.
main.crm_contact: People at customer accounts with email and phone; answers who to contact at a customer and who is the primary contact.
main.crm_customer: Customer accounts with segment, credit limit, owning sales rep and onboarding date; answers who our customers are and their commercial terms.
main.crm_opportunity: Sales pipeline deals with value, stage, expected close date and win probability; answers which deals are in progress and likely to close.
main.dim_ct_mstr: Reference master of category or type codes with descriptions and active flag; answers what a code means.
main.fct_txn_ln: Transaction line facts with date, amount, quantity and source system; answers transaction volumes and values over time.
main.hr_compensation: Employee pay history with annual salary, currency, pay grade and effective date; answers how much each employee is paid.
main.hr_department: Departments with code, name and cost centre; answers which teams exist and how they roll up for costing.
main.hr_employee: Employees with hire date, manager, department and status; answers who works here, for whom, and in which department.
main.inv_movement: Every stock movement in or out of a warehouse with quantity, direction and reason; answers how inventory changed over time.
main.inv_stock_level: Current stock on hand, reserved quantity and reorder point per product per warehouse; answers what inventory we hold and what is running low.
main.inv_warehouse: Warehouses and depots with code, name and address; answers where stock is stored.
main.sales_invoice_draft: Provisional invoices prepared from orders before issue, with state and total; answers what is queued to be billed.
main.sales_order: Customer orders with order date, status, currency, shipping address and net total; answers what customers ordered and when.
main.sales_order_line: Products, quantities, prices and discounts on each order; answers what items were ordered and at what price.
main.sales_order_status: Reference list of order statuses and whether each is final; answers what an order status code means.
main.sales_quote: Quotations sent to customers with issue and expiry dates, state and total; answers what we quoted and which quotes are still open.
main.sales_quote_line: Products, quantities and prices on each quotation; answers what was included in a quote.
main.ship_carrier: Shipping carriers with SCAC code and service level; answers which delivery companies we use.
main.ship_shipment: Outbound shipments per order with carrier, warehouse, dispatch and delivery times, status and freight cost; answers where a delivery is and whether it arrived late.
main.ship_shipment_line: Order lines and quantities included in each shipment; answers which items went in which parcel.
main.sup_purchase_order: Purchase orders raised to suppliers with date, status and total; answers what we have ordered from vendors and how much we spend.
main.sup_purchase_order_line: Products, quantities and unit costs on each purchase order; answers what we bought from a supplier and at what cost.
main.sup_supplier: Suppliers and vendors with vendor number, payment terms and status; answers who we buy from.
main.v_customer_balance: Total invoiced versus total paid per customer; answers which customers still owe money and how much.
main.v_employee_headcount: Number of employees in each department; answers how many people work in each team.
main.v_monthly_revenue: Net invoiced revenue by month and currency; answers how much money came in each month.
main.v_order_fulfilment: Each order with its shipment status, dispatch and delivery times; answers whether orders were delivered and how quickly.
main.v_stock_shortfall: Products per warehouse where available stock is below the reorder point; answers what we are running out of and need to reorder.
main.v_supplier_spend: Total purchase order value per supplier per year; answers how much we spend with each vendor.
